review.body:
<!-- factory-judge-review round=1 -->
### Factory judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — `generated` is an optional array of non-empty strings. profile.test.ts covers parsing with it, loading without it, and rejecting bad values.
- A2: met — diff-rules.test.ts passes docs/catalog/x.md (generated glob) and .changeset/y.md, and still fails an unnamed README.md.
- A3: met — rules.test.ts checks that the rule line names .changeset/ alone, and .changeset/ plus the profile's generated globs.

<details><summary>2 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- Only judgeTask passes generatedGlobs to runTier1 `packages/runtime/src/judge/tier1.ts:376` — Have every runTier1 caller that has a repo profile pass `generatedGlobs: profile?.generated`. Alternatively, have runTier1 load the profile from base itself.
- Confirm @arynbht/factory-catalog is the catalog package's published name `.changeset/markdown-in-card-generated.md:2` — Use the exact name from packages/catalog/package.json.

</details>

_Not reviewed: `packages/action/dist/SOURCE_SHA256` (generated), `packages/action/dist/index.js` (generated)._

_claude-opus-5-5 · 1 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._

suggestions.title: Only judgeTask passes generatedGlobs to runTier1
suggestions.detail: The option is optional and defaults to no globs. Any other caller of runTier1 or diffRules (for example a CLI or Action entry point not shown in this diff) still fails regenerated docs under the profile's generated globs. Only .changeset/ is skipped everywhere. The judge and the build prompt can then disagree on what passes.
suggestions.repro: Call runTier1 from a path other than judgeTask, with a profile that has generated: [docs/catalog/**] and a change that edits docs/catalog/x.md. diff.markdown-in-card fails.
suggestions.fix: Have every runTier1 caller that has a repo profile pass `generatedGlobs: profile?.generated`. Alternatively, have runTier1 load the profile from base itself.

suggestions.title: Confirm @arynbht/factory-catalog is the catalog package's published name
suggestions.detail: AGENTS.md lists @arynbht/factory, @arynbht/factory-engine and @arynbht/factory-runtime but not the catalog package. If the name doesn't match packages/catalog/package.json, `changeset version` errors.
suggestions.repro: Run `pnpm changeset status` on the branch.
suggestions.fix: Use the exact name from packages/catalog/package.json.

acceptance.note: `generated` is an optional array of non-empty strings. profile.test.ts covers parsing with it, loading without it, and rejecting bad values.
diff-rules.test.ts passes docs/catalog/x.md (generated glob) and .changeset/y.md, and still fails an unnamed README.md.
rules.test.ts checks that the rule line names .changeset/ alone, and .changeset/ plus the profile's generated globs.
